room_rent.note: Policy wording lists room rent as covered under hospitalisation expenses up to Sum Insured with no stated cap on room category or daily limit.

icu.note: ICU charges covered under hospitalisation expenses up to Sum Insured; no separate sub-limit stated.

copayment.note: No co-payment clause mentioned in the policy wording.

sub_limits.display: OPD, Maternity, Air Ambulance, Organ Donor, Physiotherapy, Recovery benefit sub-limited
sub_limits.note: Hospitalisation SI has no disease-wise sub-limits; however OPD, Maternity, Air Ambulance, Organ Donor, Physiotherapy and Recovery benefit each have separate plan-specific monetary caps.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses from first policy commencement.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 24 months of continuous coverage from first policy inception.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataracts, hernia, fistula, piles, etc.) have 12-month waiting period; joint replacement, DNS surgery, congenital internal diseases, Parkinson's, laser eye correction have 24-month waiting.

maternity.note: Inbuilt cover; limited to 2 deliveries/terminations lifetime; limit varies by plan (Plan A ₹25,000, Plan B ₹30,000, Plan C ₹35,000); both spouses must be covered under same policy.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% increase per claim-free year; maximum 50% of base SI; reduced by 10% on a claim year.

restoration.note: 100% of hospitalisation SI reinstated once per policy period after full exhaustion; only for subsequent claims not related to the illness that triggered exhaustion.

day_care.note: Indicative list of 130 procedures provided; any procedure requiring <24 hrs due to technology also covered.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation is defined in the policy but not listed as a covered benefit under Section C.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient hospitalisation covered within overall hospitalisation SI; must be in government AYUSH hospital.

organ_donor.note: Lump sum as per plan schedule; Plan A ₹50,000, Plan B ₹80,000, Plan C ₹1,00,000.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursed at actuals within overall hospitalisation SI. Air ambulance covered separately up to plan-specific limit (Plan A ₹50,000, Plan B ₹80,000, Plan C ₹1,00,000).

modern_treatments.note: 11 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, HIFU, etc.) covered up to base SI.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items listed in Annexure II are explicitly excluded.

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded for medical expenses section; PA and CI cover events worldwide but payment in India only.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes.

notable_exclusions: Treatment outside India, IVF/ART, ectopic pregnancy under maternity (covered under hospitalisation), external appliances, non-medical consumables, refractive error <7.5D
optional_riders: Ancillary Expenses (daily allowance + ICU allowance), Critical Illness cover (15 CIs), Personal Accident cover (Death/PTD/PPD/TTD)
